tenantScopeExemptOperations.CreateUser: Phase 0 seed: users are a global table keyed by Firebase UID
tenantScopeExemptOperations.CreateSchool: Phase 0 seed/bootstrap: creates the tenant itself, so there is no school yet
tenantScopeExemptOperations.UpsertUser: identity sync: users are global; the gateway passes the UID from the verified token
tenantScopeExemptOperations.SetUserLanguage: self-service on the caller's own global user row (ADR-0006)
tenantScopeExemptOperations.ProvisionSchool: platform (SUPER_ADMIN) creates the tenant itself; routed under /v1/platform
tenantScopeExemptOperations.GetUser: users are global; read by the verified token's UID
tenantScopeExemptOperations.ListMembershipsForUser: keyed by user across schools for /me and the school picker; returns only that user's own memberships
tenantScopeExemptOperations.GetSchoolBySubDomain: public subdomain lookup before any school is known; returns minimal fields only
tenantScopeExemptOperations.ListSchools: platform (SUPER_ADMIN) listing of all tenants; routed under /v1/platform
tenantScopeExemptOperations.GetInvitationByTokenHash: invitee knows only the secret token, not the school; lookup is by hash of an unguessable token

auditExemptOperations.CreateUser: Phase 0 seed operation; replaced by UpsertUser/Phase 2 modules
auditExemptOperations.CreateSchool: Phase 0 seed/bootstrap operation; platform provisioning uses the audited ProvisionSchool
auditExemptOperations.UpsertUser: the user row is the actor of every audit entry, so it cannot audit its own creation; the gateway records sign-in as a security event
auditExemptOperations.SetUserLanguage: self-service preference on the caller's own row; no tenant data and no privilege change
auditExemptOperations.CreateSchoolMember: Phase 0 seed/bootstrap (first administrator has no actor); use the audited AddMembership
auditExemptOperations.CreateAttendanceDay: first step of an attendance submit; FinishAttendanceSubmit commits it and writes the audit row
auditExemptOperations.CreateLeaveBalance: made on demand from the leave type's quota the first time a person asks for that type; HR's changes go through the audited SetLeaveBalance
auditExemptOperations.MarkNotificationRead: a marker on the reader's own inbox; it changes no school data
auditExemptOperations.MuteNotificationCategory: the reader's own preference; it changes no school data
auditExemptOperations.UnmuteNotificationCategory: the reader's own preference; it changes no school data
auditExemptOperations.SaveAttendanceMark: part of an attendance submit; FinishAttendanceSubmit or FinishAttendanceCorrection commits it and writes the audit row
auditExemptOperations.RemoveAttendanceMark: part of an attendance submit; FinishAttendanceSubmit or FinishAttendanceCorrection commits it and writes the audit row
auditExemptOperations.SaveMark: part of a marks entry; FinishMarkEntry commits it and writes the audit row
auditExemptOperations.RemoveMark: part of a marks entry; FinishMarkEntry commits it and writes the audit row
